Glasgow EPC FAQs

EPCs start from £70 for flats, with houses from £85, bungalows from £80 and maisonettes from £75.

Can landlords book EPC and Legionella together?

Yes. Glasgow landlords can request an EPC and Legionella bundle from £100 when both services are booked together.
